Micellar cleansing technology Micellar is a particle composed of water and oil. When it comes into contact with the skin, the oil molecules attract and absorb waste and makeup residues like a magnet, while supplying moisture deep inside the skin. post_title: BEAUTY OF JOSEON REVIVE EYE SERUM : GINSENG + RETINAL 30ML
post_content: What it is When we lack the protein that imparts elasticity to the dermal layer of the skin, collagen and hyaluronic acid decrease, which causes wrinkles. We created an eye serum that helps to improve wrinkles on the sensitive skin around the eyes by combining ginseng extract and retinal. From the very beginning, we knew we wanted ginseng as the base ingredient for the eye serum because there are multiple studies showing that ginseng is effective in improving wrinkles due to containing abundant amounts of saponins. Ginseng is a well-known herbal ingredient with excellent efficacy. Vitamin A was, without a doubt, the number one ingredient we wanted to combine with ginseng. There are two types of vitamin A used as cosmetic ingredients, retinol and retinal. Our most important task was to achieve ingredient stability and reduce skin irritation at the same time. 2% (active ingredient 0.02%) of retinal stabilized in the form of liposomes was blended into the formula so that customers can experience retinal for themselves. Key ingredients Ginseng root extract 10% In Donguibogam, a Korean herbal medicine book, ginseng was used as an important oriental medicine and recorded as ‘Shincho’, meaning herb from the gods. Hwang Jini, known as the most beautiful woman in the Joseon Dynasty, used a ginseng decoction as a bath water. The rich saponin contained in ginseng helps to quickly supply moisture to the skin and maintain it deep inside the skin for a long time to help create healthy skin. Retinal Liposome 2% Retinal is a vitamin A derivative and has long been used throughout the history of skin care to improve wrinkles. When vitamin A is consumed through food, it undergoes metabolic processes that transform it in the order of retinol -> retinal -> retinoic acid. Retinal, which is converted directly to retinoic acid, works faster and more effectively on the skin than retinol, which must go through the process of becoming retinal. We used a ‘retinal liposome’ that was stabilized by breaking the retinal into smaller elements and enclosing it in liposomes and then adding ingredients such as natural lipids and oils. In addition, we blend ingredients such as glycerin, niacinamide, and cholesterol together to create a more effective product. post_title: Plum 2% Hyaluronic Acid Face Serum with Bulgarian Rose 30ml
post_content:
Plum 2% Hyaluronic acid serum Formulated with soothing rose water extracts, the 2% Hyaluronic Acid Serum hydrates and calms dry & inflamed skin. It contains natural humectants that attract and retain water, leaving your skin looking plump and bouncy, making it one of the best hyaluronic acid serums for the face. What to pair with Plum 2% Hyaluronic Acid Serum? While Plum 2% Hyaluronic Acid Serum layers well with all actives, we recommend the following pairing for an enhanced skincare regimen.
1.For Skin brightening: Pair hyaluronic acid serum with niacinamide to fade blemishes and brighten skin.
2.For Enhanced glow: Pair hyaluronic acid serum with vitamin C to reduce pigmentation and dark spots.
3.For Acne: Pair hyaluronic acid serum with salicylic acid to unclog pores, remove dead skin cells, and hydrate your skin.
4.For Anti-aging: Pair hyaluronic acid serum with retinol to boost collagen and prevent premature aging. However, ensure that you do not use it more than 2-3 times a week, only in your nighttime routine.
  Note: After you apply the first serum on your face, wait a few minutes to allow it to absorb completely in your skin, and then follow up with another serum. How to use a hyaluronic acid serum:
1.Dispense 2-3 drops of Plum 2% Hyaluronic Acid Serum with Bulgarian Rose using the dropper onto your damp face. Hyaluronic acid gives the best results when used on damp skin.
2.Apply the serum evenly to your face & dab it using gentle tapping motions. Don’t forget your neck area!
When to apply:   You can incorporate hyaluronic acid serum into your daily morning and evening routines. FAQs

Q.1 Which is the best Venus product?

For the smoothest experience, try Venus Breeze. With soap gel bars, avocado oils, and body butter. Venus Breeze leaves your skin glowing. It only removes dead skin cells but leaves a beautiful freesia flowery scent on your skin.

Q.2 Where can I use Venus?

Venus is safe to use on all body parts, including hands, legs, underarms, bikini area.

Q.3 How frequently do I need to use Venus?

This depends on your hair growth, which in turn depends on DNA & hormones. On average, Venus girls use it once every week for glowing smooth skin.

Q.4 But, doesn’t shaving make the hair grow back thicker and faster?

Not possible! Hair growth only depends on DNA and hormones. The hair shaft is thinner at the top and thicker in the middle. When we shave we remove it from the thick middle part and hence when the hair grows back, it feels thicker. As soon as you feel the hair come back, just glide Venus. post_content:

How can Hydroquinone make your skin healthy?

Hydroquinone bleaches your skin by decreasing the number of melanocytes present. Melanocytes make melanin, which is what produces your skin tone.

In cases of hyperpigmentation, more melanin is present due to an increase in melanocyte production. By controlling these melanocytes, your skin will become more evenly toned over time.

It takes about four weeks on average for the ingredient to take effect. It may take several months of consistent use before you see full results.

Safety Warning

After using this product continuously for 60 days you'll need to give your skin a break and stop using the serum for 30 days. During the 30 day break, we recommend using Cos De BAHA Vitamin C Serum + AHA/BHA Toner to maintain your new glow. You can repeat this cycle to keep your skin looking bright and youthful. Hada Labo Gokujyun Premium Lotion instantly hydrates your skin and helps to preserve the optimum moisture balance.

This moisturizing Japanese lotion features an ultra -concentrated blend of 7 types of hyaluronic acid to help replenish skin and lock-in moisture. It also helps to improve dry and dehydrated skin, leaving it feeling significantly softer, supple, and silky-smooth.

A well-known Japanese beauty brand known for its high-quality skincare products at an affordable price, this Hada Labo premium product is already popular among beauty bloggers and Youtubers.

Ideal for individuals with dry and sensitive skin, the Hada Labo hyaluronic acid is free from fragrance, oil, alcohol, and colorants, meaning it won’t cause your skin to break out.

The all-new Hada Labo Hydrating Premium Lotion deeply penetrates 7 types of Hyaluronic Acid (HA) into skin layers- Hyaluronic Acid (HA), Super HA, Nano HA, Absorbent HA, 3D HA, Penetrating HA, and Fermented HA. Each type of Hyaluronic Acid serves a different and intricate purpose in gently wrapping and retaining your skin with moisture.

 

– hydrolyzed hyaluronic acid: a nano-sized hyaluronic acid for better absorption into the skin,
– sodium acetylated hyaluronate, or “super hyaluronic acid”: it provides longer-lasting surface hydration and helps to tone the skin. It’s also less sticky and more cosmetically elegant than conventional hyaluronic acid.
– hydroxypropyltrimonium hyaluronic acid: a hyaluronic acid that penetrates deep into the skin and also has a protective effect,
– hyaluronic acid crosspolymer: the famous 3D hyaluronic acid which has the specificity of absorbing 5 times more hydration than classic hyaluronic acid. This cross-linked hyaluronic acid gel forms a smoothing and plumping film on the skin and helps to deliver moisture over time.
– hyaluronic acid obtained by fermentation with Lactobacillales (a lactic acid bacterium used to ferment sake!): a fermented hyaluronic acid that allows the skin to better retain moisture,
– hydrolyzed sodium hyaluronate: a hyaluronic acid that penetrates to the stratum corneum,
– sodium hyaluronate: a hyaluronic acid that forms a plumping film on the skin.

After washing face, take an appropriate amount onto palm or cotton and blends in on face. Press into skin gently.

Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane : It protects against photoaging and tanning of the skin. Benzophenone-3 : A potent UV filter used to prevent sunburn and skin damage and as a stabilizer to prevent photo-degradation. PEG-100 Stearate : It is a non ionic emulsifier used in personal care products. Butylene Glycol : It is commonly used as a moisturizer in skincare formulations. Phospholipids : They are used technically as surface-active compounds and modulators of skin penetration. Phenoxyethanol : It has a large spectrum of antimicrobial activity and has been widely used as a preservative in cosmetic products. Glycerin : Glycerin is a humectant that improves the skin’s hydration and skin barrier function. Sclerotium Gum : It is a polysaccharide gum that works as an emulsion stabilizer and skin conditioning agent. Pullulan : It has water retention and regenerative properties to reconstruct the structural architecture of an injured or aged skin. Sodium Acrylates Copolymer : A synthetic, acrylic-based polymer that functions in cosmetics as a texture enhancer, binder, and film-forming agent. Allantoin : A potent water soluble hydrating agent that soothes and calms the inflamed skin. A great ingredient for people with sensitive skin. Disodium EDTA : Disodium EDTA and the related ingredients bind to metal ions which inactivates them. The binding of metal ions helps prevent the deterioration of cosmetics and personal care products.
